name: Kestra
description: Orchestrates event-driven workflows declared in YAML, with a REST API and MCP server so agents can trigger, monitor, and inspect pipeline executions.

skills.name: Flow Execution
skills.description: Triggers a declarative workflow and returns its execution identifier for downstream polling.

skills.name: Execution Monitor
skills.description: Inspects running and completed executions including task-level state, logs, and durations.

skills.name: Schedule Management
skills.description: Creates and inspects cron and event triggers that start workflows without manual invocation.
